tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// dbang bskur ba'i sa bcad bzhugs// ༄༅// le'u bcu pa dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang gi cho ga la gnyis te/ slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ bla ma la dad pa dang*/ brtson 'grus snying rje dam tshig ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa ste/ lnga ldan bla ma gsum dang khyad par bla ma la gus pa ste/ lnga ldan cho ga bya ba'o// de la gnyis/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel pa'i bya ba'o// de la gnyis/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ sta gon gyi cho ga'o// dang po la lngas bstan kyang sa sbyang ba'i cho ga dang*/ gzung ba'i cho ga gnyis su bsdu/ sta gon la gsum/ lha lhag par gnas pa dang*/ bum pa lhag par gnas pa dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o// dang po la gsum/ dri'i thig le bya ba dang*/ me tog tshom bu bya ba dang*/ lha rnams bskyed cing sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ mchod cing bstod de snyan gsan dbab pa'o// bum pa la gsum tshul bzhin du bsham pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bzlas pas mnyes par bya ba'o// slob ma lhag par gnas pa la bcu ste/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ tha mal pa'i rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la spro ba khyad par can bskyed pa dang*/ myur bar 'dod pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ bsrung zhing mchod pa dang*/ so shing dang*/ chu blud pa dang*/ lam gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir srung skud gdags pa dang*/ ku sha byin zhing rmi lam brtag pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa'o// dkyil 'khor gyi dus su bya ba'i cho ga la bzhi/ bri ba dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ nus pa dang ldan pas mchod pas mchod pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ thig gis bri ba dang*/ rdul tshon gyis bri ba'o// thig la gnyis/ ye shes kyi thig gi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/

las kyi thig gis cha bgo ba'o// tshon la bzhi/ byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ tshon dgye ba dang*/ mtshan ma dgod pa dang*/ der bum pa dbul zhing mchod pa bsham pa'o// byin gyis brlab pa la gnyis/ dam tshig pa bskyed pas byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pas byin gyis brlab pa'o// mchod pa la gnyis/ mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa dang*/ gtor mas mchod pa'o// spyi don tha ma la gnyis/ 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// 'jug pa la gnyis/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma 'jug pa'o// dbang la bzhi ste/ rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes dang*/ bzhi pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dbang gi cho ga la gnyis/ slob dpon dang slob ma thun mong gi dbang dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// dang po la lnga/ chu'i/ cod pan gyi/ rdo rje'i/ dril bu'i/ rigs dang rjes su mthun pa dang*/ mi rig dbang ngo*/ slob dpon gyi dbang la gnyis/ yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang ngo*// de la gnyis/ dam tshig sbyin pa dang*/ de dang rjes su 'brel pa'i gnang ba la sogs pa'o// de la bzhi/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ lung bstan pa dang*/ dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ gzengs bstod pa'o// gsang ba la gnyis/ yon dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dam tshig gi rdzas lce la byin te dbang bskur ba'o// shes rab ye shes la gnyis/ yon dang 'brel pa'i gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang sbyin pa'o// de la gsum/ rig ma rjes su gtad pa'i cho ga dang*/ dga' ba bzhi'i nyams myong bskyed pa dang*/ des slob ma'i bya ba bstan te gsum mo// dbang bzhi pa la gnyis gnyis te/ yon dang gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang gi sgo nas sbyin pa'o// thams cad kyi rjes kyi bya ba ni/ 'khor lo mchod pa dang*/ cho ga ma tshang ba dang*/ lhag ma bzod par gsol ba dang*/ mthar gshegs su gsol ba'o// 'di dag kyang gzhung dang sbyar zhing cho ga'i khrigs shes par bya'o// dbang bskur ba'i sa bcad do/// /
༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
